statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management
The recording is intended to detect and characterize intermittent rhythm abnormalities responsible for the patient's symptoms
